_how: Add a video to an album: its album and part ("all" for albums with one part; see lib/gallery.ts for the names), the link as copied from YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn, and a short title. Optionally a poster: a still photo from the video, as a file in the folder you give scripts/fetch-video-posters.py. Then run that script so YouTube videos get their thumbnail.
